item.title: Thunderstorm Advisory No. 7 #SLPRSD
item.description:
Thunderstorm Advisory No. 7 #SLPRSD
Issued at 04:00 PM 24 October 2026

Moderate to occasionally heavy rainshowers with lightning and strong winds are expected over #Catanduanes(Bagamanoc, Panganiban, Gigmoto, Baras), #Masbate(Cawayan, Palanas, Cataingan, Placer), #Albay(Manito, LegazpiCity, Daraga, Camalig, Guinobatan, CityOfLigao, Oas, Polangui, Libon, Jovellar), #CamarinesSur(Ocampo, Pili, Minalabac, NagaCity, Milaor, SanFernando, Bula, Baao, IrigaCity, Buhi, Nabua, Bato and Balatan) within the next 1 to 2 hours.

The above conditions are being experienced in #Catanduanes(Caramoran, SanAndres, SanMiguel, Virac, Bato, Viga, Pandan), #NorthernSamar, #Sorsogon(Casiguran, Juban, Magallanes, Bulan, Gubat, Pilar, Castilla, Barcelona, Irosin), #Masbate(Monreal, SanJacinto, SanFernando, Batuan, Aroroy, Baleno, Mandaon, Milagros, Balud, CityOfMasbate, Mobo, Uson, Dimasalang, PioV.Corpuz, Esperanza), #CamarinesSur(Caramoan, Presentacion, Lagonoy, SanJose, Tigaon, Sagñay, Garchitorena), #Albay(Tiwi, Malinao, Malilipot, CityOfTabaco, RapuRapu, Bacacay and SantoDomingo) which may persist within 1 to 2 hours and may affect nearby areas.

All are advised to take precautionary measures against the impacts associated with these hazards which include flash floods and landslides.

Keep monitoring for updates.
